events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Helix roster is starting to tell a real story. Herbert at QB, Mitchell getting carries, a TE room that's still a work in progress — it's a roster with a spine now. Three months ago it was a spreadsheet with ambitions. I can work with what Adam has built here.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Fronge is in Havana. Zero picks. Stroud and Croskey-Merritt and a 2028 first all walked in the door at once. I don't know what the business plan is and I'm starting to think that's the business plan.

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: Worth noting on the Herbert deal: the 2028 first that moved to Fronge is being discussed around the league as a legitimate top-five caliber pick depending on how Helix's season goes. That's not a throwaway sweetener. That's the cost of acquiring a franchise quarterback mid-build.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: EchoPoint has an elite RB room and a TE desk that is completely, utterly, embarrassingly empty. In a TE premium league. I am not screaming right now. I am concerned. The screaming comes later if Jake doesn't fix this before Week 1.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: I will give Adam this much — and I do not say this often — the Herbert acquisition is coherent. It is expensive. The 2028 first stings. But Helix now has a quarterback worth building around in a superflex format, and that is not a small thing. Credit where it is due. Now let's see if the model actually delivers.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Lot of Helix discourse on the timeline today and it's all well and good but can we talk about Deepwater for five minutes? Mitchum is at $68.70, the board wants a direction, and nobody is saying anything. That silence is a take in itself.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: The Monarch situation is not getting enough attention. Shaq didn't make a single trade all of last season, added Zavion Thomas off waivers, and still hasn't touched the RB depth. The WR room is loaded and completely illiquid. At some point the roster construction has to match the format — 0.5 PPR doesn't care how good your wideouts look on paper if you can't run the ball.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Everyone is now very suddenly interested in what Fronge is building in Havana. Funny. I've been asking what ForgeHammer's endgame looks like since before the relocation was announced. The pick liquidity problem didn't start this offseason. It's been the story the whole time.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Thursday's Exchange Report has a full Helix breakdown, a segment on the Deepwater drift that Clara has been asking about for two weeks, and Vance has promised to be calm about the EchoPoint TE situation. We will see. Seven PM.
